items.title: Does RTX Stock Chart Its Own Course?
items.summary: The aerospace and defense giant is standing out in a weak market, but its real value lies in a long history of moving independently.

items.title: These 4 Earnings Reports Expose the Market’s Growing Economic Divide
items.summary: Northrop Grumman, D.R. Horton, Capital One and Charles Schwab reported Q2 earnings beats on July 21, revealing diverging trends in defense, housing and financials sectors.

items.title: US and Japan join Philippines for South China Sea military drills
items.summary: Investing.com -- The United States and Japan joined the Philippines for five days of maritime exercises in the South China Sea as Manila and Beijing traded accusations over several confrontations in the disputed waters, Reuters reported.

items.title: Russian attack on Kyiv triggers fires across Ukrainian capital
items.summary: Investing.com -- Falling debris from an overnight Russian attack triggered fires in at least three districts of Kyiv early Sunday, Reuters reported, citing Mayor Vitali Klitschko.

items.title: SpaceX (SPCX) Launches Northrop Grumman Repair Mission And Opens A New Service Market
items.summary: Space Exploration Technologies (NasdaqGS:SPCX) launched Northrop Grumman's MRV-MEP satellite repair mission, focused on on-orbit servicing. The mission centers on maintaining and extending the life of existing satellites rather than placing new hardware in orbit. This launch adds a new service-focused line of activity tied to long-term space infrastructure needs. items.title: Defense Earnings Show Readiness Now and Modernization Ahead
items.summary: Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and RTX posted record backlogs and raised guidance this week, driven by both near-term missile defense demand and long-term military modernization programs.
